fix: Segment once per public call and pass the slice down. Change word_range_at(text, position) to word_range_in(text_len, boundaries: &[usize], position) and build the Vec once in word_leading/word_trailing before the loop: let boundaries = word_boundaries(text); then call word_range_in(text.len(), &boundaries, clamp_position(text, position)) inside the loop. word_boundary_at can call the same helper.

Build the result with one exact-size copy via replacing, not self.value() plus TextEditingDelta::apply (which clones the whole text again and then replace_range may regrow it): let mut next = self.replacing(|_| delta.range, &delta.replacement); if let Some(selection) = delta.selection { next.selection = selection.clamp_to(&next.text); } next.composing = delta.composing.map(|range| range.clamp_to(&next.text)); self.update_user(next);

Do not clone the text to change only the selection. Read base and the clamped target with with_value, then write the selection with update_ranges as set_selection already does: let base = self.with_value(|value| value.selection.base); let target = self.with_value(|value| nearest_char_boundary(&value.text, target.min(value.text.len()))); let selection = if extend { TextSelection::new(base, target) } else { TextSelection::collapsed(target) }; self.update_ranges(|value| value.selection = selection); then keep the preferred_caret_x and caret_affinity assignments.

Copy only the selection, not the whole text. Replace with: let selection = self.with_value(|value| value.selection); let extent = selection.extent; and then use selection instead of value.selection in the collapse branch (if !extend && !selection.is_collapsed() ...; selection.end(), selection.start()). Every arrow-key visual move otherwise clones the full document.

Each observe() subscriber clones the whole text on every change, so N observers cost N full copies per keystroke. Take one snapshot per change (e.g. store Rc<TextEditingValue> in ControllerState, rebuilt only in update_committed and update_ranges when value changes) and have observers clone the Rc. Keep the borrow dropped before calling listener, since listeners may edit the controller.
